title: Made a small fishing game, second try after a failed first version - is it worth continuing?
author: SeaworthinessFit6280
selftext:
Hey everyone, I posted this game once before but honestly that version was pretty rough, so I took it down and spent the last weeks fixing a lot of stuff. This is my first game ever and it's still a raw demo, so please go easy on me :)   
It's a chill float fishing game - you cast, watch the bobber, strike at the right moment and try to land the fish. Right now there are 3 locations (two ponds and a small river with current), 15 fish species, different baits, groundbait, floats, rods, reels etc.   
What's already working: 

\- server-side saves, so your progress doesn't get lost 

\- online chat with other players 

\- global records table for every fish 

The plan is to release it on mobile, and later add a lot more locations, gear and fish. So my main question is - does this game have a chance, or should I move on? Any feedback is welcome, good or bad. Bugs, what's annoying, what's confusing, what you'd like to see.

Plays in the browser (works on phone too, use fullscreen): [https://kholodniuk.itch.io/fishing-nostalgy](https://kholodniuk.itch.io/fishing-nostalgy)  
  
Thanks for checking it out!
